notes.title: Progress of the Extended Demo
notes.content:
We're currently working on the extended Demo of Ecosphere, which we expect to launch in [b]January 2025[/b]. Here's what you'll be able to expect:

[list]
[*] First hour of the game
[*] Meeting with three potential love interests and the last one will be kept secret ;)
[*] 6 Computer graphics
[*] A new home screen
[*] 8 original audio tracks, loopable for added immersion
[/list]
A [b]new trailer[/b] is also in preparation to introduce you to this project, which the team is working hard to bring to fruition ✨

notes.title: Storyteller's Festival & Demo available
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that Ecosphere has been selected to take part in the Storyteller's Festival! To mark the occasion, we've released a demo to show you a ten-minute sequence of gameplay with the essential features:

[h3]Impact assessment[/h3]

Your choices will have an impact on the universe. First of all, your decisions will shape the heroine's personality: boldness, prudence, or diplomacy, influencing your relationships with the two love interests. For example, Leily is attracted to bold girls but dislikes diplomatic behavior... A reputation system will also help you manage your relationships with NPCs.

[h3]Explore mode[/h3]

Combining both Point & Click and Drag & Drop mechanics, you can interact with the scenery to find clues and deepen the game's lore.

[h3]QTE sequences[/h3]

A dynamic choice system lets you manage action scenes as you wish. But beware: some actions are more relevant than others... Success will depend on how well you analyze the context and your environment!

We hope you enjoy this demo! Don't hesitate to share your feedback with us on social networks - it'll be a great help to us as we continue development!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2519860/Ecosphere/]Demo here ![/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.3 released !
notes.content:
Patch 1.3 is now available ! It incorporates a lot of the feedback we've received in trade shows, which has enabled us to fine-tune the project and bring you a host of new features:

• New game interface
• Overhauled point & click mechanics: now you can explore the scenery on your own to find points of interest. If you need to, the help button will tell you where they are.
• Checkpoint system: to avoid having to restart the entire game in the event of a game over. When you enter a new setting, a checkpoint is automatically activated.
• The game is fully accessible to blind people and partially sighted.
• Added a button at the end of the Prologue to direct you to the Steam page for the full game, and why not add it to your wishlist? ːsteamhappyː

We're also working on the development of a one-hour demo that will tell the story of Leily Stirner's encounter with the Master Engineer's daughter...

Full steam ahead!

notes.title: New Patch in July !
notes.content:
Hi everyone! A lot has happened since the launch of Ecosphere - Prologue last December, and we've obviously continued to work on the rest of the project! We've joined an incubator specializing in creative industries, Plaine Images, and their support has enabled us to improve the Prologue: a new version was presented at Game Camp 2023, an event that brings together French video game professionals once a year. Their invaluable advice will enable us to improve the project even further.

 Here are the changes to the patch, which will go live in early July:
• New interface
• A checkpoint system to avoid having to restart the game after a game over.
• Improved Point & Click system

We've also been working on a long demo to reveal the first hour of gameplay, taking up the story where we left off at the end of the Prologue and recounting the eventful encounter between Leily Stirner and the Master Engineer's daughter, Arane Kross.

More news very soon!
